title: Finance Office Basis for Settling a Resort Lodging Folio and Releasing the Incidental Hold
content:
## Two clauses no longer in force

That the folio is presented on departure and settled before the party leaves the mountain has been superseded by the current basis on which a Resort Lodging folio is settled, and is no longer in force. That the deposit already taken is applied against the folio first, then any lodging credit the household holds, with the remainder taken from the payment method on file, has likewise been superseded and is no longer in force.

## When a deposit may be applied or returned

A deposit is applied or returned only while the reservation stands as checked out, as given up or as unclaimed, and the standing is read off the collective's reservation record before the deposit is moved. Where the deposit is larger than the folio, the difference goes back to the method it came from.

## Releasing the incidental hold

The incidental hold is released no later than the unit type's release period counted in business days from the day the party departed. Business days are counted forward from the anchor date, the anchor date itself counting as day zero, only days the collective's finance office is open counting, which excludes Saturdays, Sundays and the collective's published holidays, and business days are never mixed with calendar days.

The anchor is the day of departure as the collective's reservation record carries it, and the boundary day itself is within the period.

## Damage found after departure

Damage found after departure is charged against the hold up to the unit type's liability cap, and anything beyond the cap is a matter for the collective's insurers rather than for the desk.

### Counting the release period (a hypothetical departure, on a unit type whose release period is 5 business days)

A party departing on a Wednesday makes that Wednesday day zero. The Thursday is the first business day and the Friday the second; the Saturday and the Sunday are not days the finance office is open and do not count; the Monday is the third, the Tuesday the fourth and the following Wednesday the fifth. A hold released on that following Wednesday is released not later than the boundary day and is within the period; a hold released on the Thursday after it is not.

superseded_clauses: The deposit already taken is applied against the folio first, then any lodging credit the household holds, and the remainder is taken from the payment method on file.
The folio is presented on departure and settled before the party leaves the mountain.
